newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican army general dies in helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Mexican army general dies in helicopter crash.

text.p: A Mexican army general was killed on Thursday when a military helicopter crashed into a remote mountainside in the troubled southern state of Guerrero, the defence ministry said.

It said Gen. Gilberto Renato Garcia Gonzalez, commander of the 27th Military Zone based in Acapulco, died and three soldiers were injured when their helicopter was thrown out of control by a sudden air current as it was landing.

Guerrero, one of Mexico's poorest and most lawless states, is an area of operations of the leftist Popular Revolutionary Army (EPR) guerrilla movement. It is also an important centre of illegal drugs production.
The defence ministry said the helicopter was blown into a mountainside in the remote municipality of Heleodoro Castillo, at least 12 hours' drive from the state capital Chilpancingo.
Local journalists said the crash site lay in mountains above the village of Atoyac where armed drugs gangs grow poppies used in the manufacture of heroin.
President Ernesto Zedillo had sent his condolences to the general's widow, the defence ministry said.
